dataset: FEC Statistical Summary of 15-Month Campaign Activity of the 2025-2026 Election Cycle
accounting_notes: PAC total receipts and disbursements include subtypes such as independent-expenditure-only and hybrid committees; subtype values are analytical decompositions and must not be added to the PAC total.
Independent expenditures are a spending category and overlap committee disbursements; they must not be added to total PAC disbursements as if they were separate economic activity.
An independent expenditure is money paid to a vendor or other person. Candidate support/opposition is a separate semantic relationship, not a transfer of money to the candidate.
Independent-expenditure-only political committees are prohibited from contributing directly to candidates.
